Rules.InvariantScript:
// Haal het record opnieuw op zodat bewerkingen elders meteen zichtbaar zijn.
If(
    !IsBlank(varCurrentAsset.'Id (ID)'),
    Set(varCurrentAsset, LookUp(Equipment_Assets, 'Id (ID)' = varCurrentAsset.'Id (ID)'))
);
Set(
    varAssetFields,
    Table(
        { FieldName: "Device name",            FieldValue: Coalesce(varCurrentAsset.DeviceName, "-") },
{ FieldName: "Manufacturer",           FieldValue: Coalesce(varCurrentAsset.Manufacturer, "-") },
        { FieldName: "Serial number",            FieldValue: Coalesce(varCurrentAsset.SerialNumber, "-") },
        { FieldName: "UA number",              FieldValue: Coalesce(varCurrentAsset.UANumber, "-") },
        { FieldName: "Setup(s)",               FieldValue: If(
            IsEmpty(varCurrentAsset.Setups),
            "-",
            Concat(varCurrentAsset.Setups, Value, ", ")
        ) },
        { FieldName: "Campus",                 FieldValue: Coalesce(varCurrentAsset.CurrentCampus.Value, "-") },
        { FieldName: "Room",                 FieldValue: Coalesce(varCurrentAsset.'CurrentLocation (CurrentLocation0)'.Value, "-") },
        { FieldName: "Owner group",         FieldValue: Coalesce(varCurrentAsset.OwnerGroup.Value, "-") },
        { FieldName: "User group",        FieldValue: Coalesce(varCurrentAsset.UserGroup.Value, "-") },
        { FieldName: "Status",                 FieldValue: Coalesce(varCurrentAsset.Status.Value, "-") },
        { FieldName: "Assigned to",          FieldValue: Coalesce(varCurrentAsset.CurrentHolder.DisplayName, "-") },
        { FieldName: "Last moved by", FieldValue: Coalesce(varCurrentAsset.LastRelocatedBy.DisplayName, "-") },
        { FieldName: "Last maintenance",      FieldValue: If(IsBlank(varCurrentAsset.LastMaintenanceDate), "-", Text(varCurrentAsset.LastMaintenanceDate, DateTimeFormat.ShortDate)) },
        { FieldName: "Next maintenance",      FieldValue: If(IsBlank(varCurrentAsset.NextMaintenanceDue), "-", Text(varCurrentAsset.NextMaintenanceDue, DateTimeFormat.ShortDate)) },
        { FieldName: "Commissioning required", FieldValue: Coalesce(varCurrentAsset.CommissioningRequired.Value, "-") },
{ FieldName: "Commissioning done",     FieldValue: If(
    IsEmpty(varCurrentAsset.CommissioningDone),
    "-",
    Concat(varCurrentAsset.CommissioningDone, Value, ", ")
) },
{ FieldName: "Last updated",      FieldValue: If(IsBlank(varCurrentAsset.LastUpdated), "-", Text(varCurrentAsset.LastUpdated, DateTimeFormat.ShortDateTime24)) }
    )
)

Filter(
    Assets_Documents,
    Not('{IsFolder}'),
    EndsWith('{Path}', "/" & varCurrentAsset.Titel & "/")
        || AssetID = varCurrentAsset.Titel
)
"No documents yet. Open the folder to add one."

Sort(
    Filter(Equipment_MovementLog, Title = varCurrentAsset.Titel),
    TimeStamp,
    SortOrder.Descending
)
"This asset has not been moved through the app yet."

Sort(
    Filter(Equipment_Tickets, Title = varCurrentAsset.Titel),
    ReportedDate,
    SortOrder.Descending
)

"reported by " & Coalesce(ThisItem.ReportedBy.DisplayName, "?") &
 If(IsBlank(ThisItem.ReportedDate), "", " on " & Text(ThisItem.ReportedDate, DateTimeFormat.ShortDate)) &
 If(
     IsBlank(ThisItem.ResolvedDate),
     "",
     "   |   resolved by " & Coalesce(ThisItem.ResolvedBy.DisplayName, "?") &
     ": " & Left(Coalesce(ThisItem.ResolutionNotes, "no notes"), 60)
 )
"No issues reported for this asset yet."
